thesis: China's leading direct-chat recruitment platform, with net cash, a 50.9% FCF margin and accelerating 14.1% revenue growth, trades below its own 5-year minimum on every multiple at a 9.28% FCF yield, pricing a China/VIE discount that its fundamentals do not show.
reason: Quality is rising, the business is cash-backed and the price is below its own 5-year minimum multiples, so the asymmetry justifies the 7% conviction-4 size. Two things keep conviction off 5: 4.74% dilution and a China VIE exposure that overlaps with HKG:9999. Communication Services goes to about 14% of the portfolio and cash stays far above the reserve, so no replacement is needed.

triggers.text: TTM operating margin falls below the FY2024 level of 16.0%, showing the AI-matching and network-effect cost advantage has eroded.
TTM gross margin falls below the FY2023 five-year low of 82.2%, signalling pricing or competitive pressure on employer paid services.
TTM FCF margin falls below the FY2023 level of 35.1%, showing the cash-generation step-up was transitory.
Reported quarterly revenue (company release / income statement) declines YoY for two consecutive quarters, ending the growth acceleration seen in Q2 2026 (+14.1%).

thesis: A 23%-operating-margin, high-ROIC assisted tax-prep leader trades in the bottom fifth of its own 5-year multiples at a 13.92% FCF yield, where the price implies a -15.4% revenue decline that guided growth and 6% annual share shrinkage do not support.
reason: Cheap on every own-history and peer multiple, improving margins, self-funded buybacks and a non-cyclical, low-beta demand base give a favourable skew even on conservative EV/EBITDA-based targets. Disruption risk and INTU overlap keep conviction at 4, not 5: standard 7% core size. Cash, sector and holding limits are not breached.

triggers.text: TTM gross margin falls below 43%, breaking the five-year low (44.3% TTM, 44.3%-45.7% FY range), signalling price pressure from free/AI filing alternatives.
TTM operating margin falls below 20%, under the five-year low of 21.5% (FY2022), showing the margin expansion has reversed.
TTM FCF margin falls below 15%, under the FY2025 five-year low of 15.9%, meaning cash generation no longer funds the buyback and dividend.
Annual revenue (income statement) declines year on year for a full fiscal year, or management discloses a loss of assisted-category share, evidencing real displacement by free or DIY filing.
